_comment: Which overlay FILE is resident in each of F12/F13/F15's own fixtures, decided from bytes; how ambiguous each governing address is across the candidate images; the scene id actually held by every fixture; and the campaign progression table read from the shipped executable. nontrivial_definition: positions where NOT (ram_byte == 0 && image_byte == 0); zero-vs-zero agreement is excluded because padding otherwise flatters every low-entropy image
anchor_rule: 64-byte slices with >= 32 distinct byte values, up to 8 per image, searched across all 2097152 bytes of main RAM; >= 2 slices agreeing on one implied base is residency evidence
